name: Goomy
description: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, raising its defensive stats.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Shelter
moves.description: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, raising its defensive stats. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
